name: The Colony
description: Home base. Survivors here contribute to the food supply and colony morale.

name: Gas Station
description: Fuel and tools can be found here, but it attracts zombies.

name: Grocery Store
description: Best source of food, but shelves are often bare.

name: Hospital
description: Medicine and medical tools are plentiful here.

name: Police Station
description: Weapons and useful tools for holding the perimeter.

name: School
description: A large building with varied supplies but many hiding places for zombies.

name: Library
description: Knowledge is power — crossroads cards may be drawn here.
